name: cloudflared

storage.rationale: This tool has no tool-owned persistent storage in the supported Vrooli workflow; the explicit empty declaration records that caches or credentials are owned by the invoking workflow.

description: Cloudflare Tunnel client for exposing local services via secure tunnels
installHint: Stage the resource-owned pinned release with scenario-dependency-analyzer deps install source/cloudflared@2026.10.7 --scenario cloudflared --surface host-tool --exact --apply
notes: This entry projects the resource-owned pinned release into host requirements and carries no acquisition of its own. The checksummed per-platform targets live in resources/cloudflared/resource.json, which is the vendorable item a desktop bundle stages; as a standalone tool requirement, cloudflared must already be staged on the host.
